title: [Hiring] Account Executive / Creator Outreach | Remote Argentina | $700–900 USD/mo + commission
description:
Remote creator / social management agency. We work with creators in the US and LATAM. Small team, real promotions in weeks or months.

Junior outreach, not a senior hunter. Find creators and brands, open conversations, book calls, hand them to the team. We train you (training is English-only). Day-to-day is Spanish.

What you'll do: - Prospect creators and brands (Instagram, LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp) - Outbound and book calls - Clean CRM and weekly activity targets

Need: - Based in Argentina, fully remote - Native Spanish (Rioplatense is great) - English good enough to follow training and write a simple email - Gen-Z native and fluent in that culture - Junior is fine. Sales, agency, or social is a plus - Mon–Fri, 9am–6pm Argentina time

Pay: $700–900 USD/month guaranteed base + commission. Typical $1,500+ from month 3–4 on this team (never commission-only).

Apply: reply to this post in English with LinkedIn or CV + 5 lines on why you.
